newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Telekom completes phone firm acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Telekom completes phone firm acquisition.

text.p: Telekom Malaysia Bhd said it has concluded the acquisition of the entire issued and paid-up capital of MRCB Telecommunication Sdn Bhd.
A statement from the state-controlled company late on Tuesday said the transaction was adjusted to 635 milllion ringgit, from an original purchase price of 640 million after an audit.
The acquisition of the mobile phone operator, formerly a unit of Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd, was settled in cash.
Telekom said the acquisition would enable it to build a larger presence in the cellular phone market and strongly complement its existing cellular network, Atur-450.
Telekom also currently operates another network, Mobifon 800, through a 30 percent stake in Mobikom Sdn Bhd.
